facts.statement: SOE president John Smedley gave a keynote at the ION Games Conference 2008 in which he discussed Free Realms and The Agency.
facts.quote: SOE's president goes into many of the future issues of MMOs and how SOE plans to deal with them, talking about The Agency and Free Realms in particular.

article_summaries.title: Video: John Smedley Keynote at ION '08
article_summaries.summary: Ten Ton Hammer posted a video of SOE president John Smedley's keynote at the ION Games Conference 2008. The article says Smedley discussed The Agency and Free Realms, but the page text gives no specific Free Realms design details, so it offers little for a rebuild beyond confirming that SOE was publicly discussing Free Realms in May 2008, before launch. The full substance is only in the embedded video, which is not in the captured text.
